untrustedWorkspaces.description: Read-only analysis is available. A workspace cannot choose the executable; workspace MCP setup requires trust.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Syntax highlighting is available for virtual files. Model analysis is available for file-backed and untitled Dynare documents.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run lint && npm run compile && npm run bundle

dynare.editorActions.description: Locations for model actions. Commands remain in the Command Palette. An empty list hides toolbar and context-menu actions.

dynare.diagnosticActions.ignore.description: Offer Ignore this check in diagnostic quick fixes. Hidden checks can still be restored with Show a hidden check or Show all hidden checks.

dynare.blockTint.enabled.description: Shade recognized Dynare blocks. When off, all Dynare block tints are disabled.

dynare.MATLAB/OctaveTint.description: Shade MATLAB or Octave code embedded in a Dynare file, including verbatim contents.

dynare.tintPalette.description: Choose the background colors for Dynare blocks and embedded MATLAB or Octave code.

model.aggregate.description: Background style for aggregate model blocks.

model.heterogeneous.description: Background style for heterogeneous model blocks.

dynare.blockTint.styles.description: Choose a style for individual Dynare blocks. Blocks without an entry use their default style.

dynare.blockTint.heterogeneousModels.description: Choose a style by written heterogeneous model dimension. A dimension entry takes priority over the heterogeneous model block style.

dynare.inactiveCode.enabled.description: Dim source excluded by the selected analysis configuration, including branch previews.

dynare.effectiveModel.macroTint.description: Shade macro-expanded text in the macro expansion preview with a faint background. Resolved against the preview's chosen root.

dynare.nameDetails.longName.description: Show written long_name in hover, completion and Outline.

dynare.nameDetails.tex.description: Show written TeX as literal text in hover, completion and Outline.

dynare.parameterValueHints.description: Show proven expression values at top-level assignments. Also respects native editor inlay-hint visibility.

dynare.workspaceDiagnostics.description: Check unopened saved .mod and .dyn models in workspace folders. Turning this off cancels background work and clears its workspace reports.

dynare.workspaceExcludePaths.description: Skip paths during background checks of unopened models in this folder. Open files and dependencies are still checked. Use *, ?, **, or a directory ending with /.

dynare.outline.sections.description: Sections shown in Outline, breadcrumbs and quick outline. Empty hides all sections.

dynare.outline.equationNumbers.description: Show Dygnosis equation numbers before transformation in Outline.

dynare.outline.activity.description: Default macro activity filter for Outline and breadcrumbs. Use Filter Outline by macro activity for an open model. Mixed and unknown entries remain visible in each mode.

dynare.statusBar.counts.description: Choose the model counts and their order in the status bar. An empty list hides the model status item.

dynare.diff.defaultChangeKinds.description: Choose which changes a new Changes view shows first. Uses the model that opened the view. An empty list hides all rows.

dynare.searchPaths.description: Add directories for include lookup. Relative paths start at the model root's workspace folder or, for a loose file, its directory. An include uses its chosen model root. Untitled files have no disk base.

dynare.analysisConfigurations.description: Use Save current configuration in the model's configuration picker. Presets belong to the model's workspace folder. User settings and multi-root workspace-wide values are ignored.

analysis.description: Macro inputs and preview choices saved by Dygnosis.

equation_selection.description: Select equations by explicit tag values for analysis.

includePaths.description: Replace this root’s search paths for this selection. Omit to inherit Search Paths.

bindings.description: Written directive evidence saved by Dygnosis for guarded overrides.

dynare.serverPath.description: Absolute path to a custom Dygnosis LSP executable. Empty uses the bundled LSP. MCP uses dygnosis-mcp beside the selected LSP executable. Set only in user/machine settings.

dynare.macroWorkLimit.description: Increase the work allowance for unusually large macro programs. It applies per checked model root, including its includes. Output size, source size, value size and nesting have separate limits.

semanticTokenTypes.description: A Dynare exogenous or deterministic exogenous variable.

semanticTokenModifiers.description: Forward-looking timing of a Dynare endogenous variable.
Predetermined timing of a Dynare endogenous variable.

colors.description: Blue cue for a paired Replaced model row in Changes. Before and After fields keep removal and addition cues.

Subtle background for Dynare and MATLAB/Octave tinting. Supports transparency.
Character-range background for macro-expanded text in the effective-model preview. Supports transparency.
Amber palette standard tint background. Supports transparency.
Amber palette subtle tint background. Supports transparency.
Violet palette standard tint background. Supports transparency.
Violet palette subtle tint background. Supports transparency.

Slate palette subtle tint background. Supports transparency.
